title: Eric Davis offers full testimony for blanket immunity
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Eric Davis offers full testimony for blanket immunity, about recent at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Eric Davis is actually on record as part of James Fox's last movie saying if you give me blanket immunity, I will say everything I know.

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that the physicist Eric Davis, a scientist linked to Pentagon work on UFOs, went on record in the latest film by documentary maker James Fox. Weinstein says Davis stated that if he were given blanket immunity from prosecution, he would tell everything he knows, which would suggest he holds secrets he cannot legally share.
